You flagged this yourself (Instagram, @acm_chi). Free to submit, no academic affiliation required, and a meet-up is the least gatekept way to lead a session at CHI: an 'XR for heritage / Global South' meet-up would be a real credential. Two caveats before you spend the time: they prefer two or more organizers from two different organizations (Dr. Laura Harrison or the Unique Mappers Network would satisfy that), and at least one organizer must register and attend in person in Pittsburgh, May 10 to 14, 2027, or the meet-up is cancelled, so budget the registration and travel first. Three-page proposal via PCS. chi2027.acm.org/authors/meet-ups (deadline passed, not applied, per the deadline alarm on October 3, 2026)

You flagged this yourself. Up to EUR 7,000 for travel, free to apply, and you are exactly who it is for: a Tunisian artist whose professional travel runs between the US and Tunisia. Either the departure or the arrival country has to be in the Arab region, which your trips satisfy. Deadline verified September 21, 2026 at mawred.org: three rounds a year, cut-offs 16:00 Beirut time on January 16 (results February 28), May 29 and September 17 — the September round closed four days ago, so January 16 is the next one. Plan it around a specific trip: the activity you travel for must take place after the results date of the round you apply to, so a January application only covers travel from March 2027 on.

Lowest-effort item on this list. The XR Women Museum is taking rolling contributions to its Community Garden: 3D and XR-ready objects, interactive “pollinators”, botanical or spatial fragments, world-building elements. It is explicitly not a juried selection, so a Tanit XR scan — a Kerkouane fragment, a piece of the building kit — goes straight into a standing XR ecosystem in front of the XR Women audience. Free, remote, a Google form, no deadline. Verified on xrwomen.com/museum September 21, 2026.

Your note has carried this since Sept 20; verified at the source September 22, 2026 and now on the board. Two free routes into the CHI workshops track. Judge one instead: email name, affiliation, CV and a 150-word statement to workshops@chi2027.acm.org by September 28 for about eight hours of reviewing in October and November. The juror route asks for regular CHI attendance, so the proposal route is the realistic one for you. Same in-person catch as the meet-up: CHI 2027 is Pittsburgh, May 10-14, 2027.
